reply.text: That's not something training can fix — that pattern of panic around going over a number is worth talking to a doctor or therapist about, especially one who works with eating and food. I can keep things general with you on the training and eating-enough side, but I'm not the right person to untangle that part, and I'd rather point you to someone who is. What I can do is keep working with you on your actual training — want to talk about what's on your plate program-wise this week?
